gemini.title: Table Uv208 Gaelic Language Skills Datazone
gemini.abstract: Table Uv208 Gaelic Language Skills Datazone is an authoritative dataset published by National Records of Scotland. It contains records relating to table uv208 gaelic language skills datazone.
gemini.lineage: Published by National Records of Scotland as open statistics and boundary data. Loaded into Systra PostGIS database without transformation.
